# Collective Loft

> Collective Loft (collectiveloft.com) is a professional network for the creative class: artists, musicians, writers, designers, filmmakers, photographers, performers, and creative technologists. Members find collaborators, agree on real terms (compensation, rights, timeline) before work begins, and work together in a shared workspace called a Loft Studio. Every finished collaboration leaves a record: terms honored, work completed, ratings earned.

Collective Loft is not a gig marketplace and not a job board. It is structured agreement infrastructure for creative collaboration. Joining is free and a free member is a full member: a profile, findable in Discover and Discipline Matching, reachable by others, able to agree terms, work in a Loft Studio, get paid and build a rating. Membership at $10 a month, tax inclusive, billed through Paddle as merchant of record after a 7-day free trial, buys the right to START things: posting a Collab Brief and reaching out to someone first. Enrolled students verify a school email address and get that for nothing. It is a Morgan Collective Group company, based in Chicago and London. Launched August 1, 2026 with a hand-picked founding class, now closed.
